PLAN "12-Week Resistance and Conditioning Programme for PCOS-first-line insulin sensitivity"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and lean mass with sustainable, evidence-informed resistance training"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation & Low Volume":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6.5 rest 75 seconds
          overhead_press 2x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Movement Quality & Mobility":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full-Body Light":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Progression A":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Technique & Tempo":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Conditioning & Core":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..7 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30 seconds rpe 4 rest 0 seconds
        cooldown:
          plank 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Strength & Volume Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 6.5 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          overhead_press 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Hypertrophy Emphasis":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          cable_row 4x10..12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 50m "Active Recovery & Core":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          incline_press 3x12..15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x10..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 2 minutes

NUTRITION_PLAN
  GOAL glycaemic_control:
    name "Glycaemic control focused nutrition to support insulin sensitivity and sustainable energy balance"

  STRUCTURE
    DAILY_EATING_PATTERN
      - meal_frequency: "3 main meals + optional 1-2 snacks"
      - protein_target: "1.2..1.6 g per kg body weight per day; adjust as needed"
      - carbohydrate_distribution: "balanced across meals; emphasize low GI sources and fiber-rich carbs"
      - fat_sources: "include healthy fats (olives, avocado, nuts, fatty fish) in each day"
      - fiber_target: "25-35 g per day"
      - hydration: "≥ 30 ml/kg body weight per day

  GLUCOSE_MANAGEMENT_STRATEGIES
    - moderate_energy_intake: "monitor energy intake to avoid under-fuelling; adjust every 1-2 weeks based on hunger cues and body weight"
    - fiber_focus: "prioritize soluble and insoluble fiber to aid glycemic control; e.g., oats, legumes, vegetables"
    - lean_protein: "distribute protein evenly across meals to support satiety and LEA"
    - low_glycemic_sources: "choose whole grains, legumes, non-starchy vegetables, berries over high-GI options"
    - sugary_drink_limit: "avoid sugar-sweetened beverages; prefer water, unsweetened tea, and black coffee"
    - snacks: "if needed, select protein-rich snacks with fiber (greek yogurt + berries, nuts + fruit, hummus with veggies)"
    - alcohol: "limit or avoid; if consumed, do so with meals to reduce glycemic impact"

  ACTIVITY_INTEGRATION
    - exercise_carb_aware: "align pre/post workout nutrition to training load; higher workouts may include a small carb-containing snack pre-workout if energy is low"
    - peri_workout_fuel: "ensure hydration and consider 10-20 g fast-acting carbohydrate if training >60 minutes or very demanding"
    - recovery: "prioritize sleep (7-9 hours) and stress management to improve insulin sensitivity"

  MONITORING
    - metrics: "weight, morning fasting glucose if available, energy levels, menstrual regularity, training adherence"
    - cadence: "review every 4 weeks and adjust portions, carb timing, and fiber targets accordingly"

CARDIO
  PLAN_NAME "Phase 1 Cardiovascular Progression"
  TYPE cardio
  VISIBILITY public
  MODALITIES
    - walking: "progressive duration to 30 minutes, 3x/week"
    - cycling: "easy/moderate, 20-30 minutes, 2x/week"
  SESSIONS
    - WEEK 1:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Accessory 20m" modality walking 20m
    - WEEK 2:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Accessory 25m" modality walking 25m
    - WEEK 3:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Accessory 28m" modality walking 28m
    - WEEK 4:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Progression 30m" modality walking 30m
  NOTES
    - aim for 2-3 cardio sessions per week on non-consecutive days
    - adjust intensity to avoid overtraining; RPE around 5-6 during cardio
    - if weight loss stalls, consider small incremental daily activity increase outside structured sessions

CARDIO
  PLAN_NAME "Phase 2 Cardiovascular Progression with HIIT Option"
  TYPE cardio
  VISIBILITY public
  MODALITIES
    - walking: "include HIIT intervals when ready; alternate steady-state and interval blocks"
  SESSIONS
    - WEEK 5:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Progression 32m with HIIT 6x30s on/90s off" modality walking 32m
    - WEEK 6:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Progression 34m with HIIT 8x20s on/40s off" modality walking 34m
  NOTES
    - HIIT should be implemented only if she tolerates training load; start with conservative intervals
    - monitor RPE and recovery; avoid daily HIIT in Phase 1, consider 1 HIIT day per week maximum while Phase 1 active

CARDIO
  PLAN_NAME "Phase 3 Cardiovascular Progression with HIIT Maintenance"
  TYPE cardio
  VISIBILITY public
  MODALITIES
    - walking: "maintain HIIT option with 1 day/week if recovered"
  SESSIONS
    - WEEK 9:
        DAY Tuesday: "Cardio Maintenance 28m with optional HIIT 6x20s on/40s off" modality walking 28m
  NOTES
    - keep HIIT conservative; priority remains resistance training and glycemic control

1RM_TEST
  GOAL "End of Phase 3 1RM assessment"
  TYPE assessment
  VISIBILITY public
  EXERCISES
    - squat 1RM
    - bench_press 1RM
    - bent_over_row 1RM
  SCHEDULE
    - WEEK 12:
        DAY Friday: "1RM Testing Day" duration 60m
        components:
          - warmup: walking 5 minutes
          - progressive warmup sets for each lift:
              squat 2x5 rpe 7, 1x3 rpe 8
              bench_press 2x5 rpe 7, 1x3 rpe 8
              bent_over_row 2x5 rpe 7, 1x3 rpe 8
          - attempt_1RM for each exercise in sequence with rest 3–5 minutes between attempts
  NOTES
    - ensure technique priority; stop if form breaks
    - adjust load targets based on 1RM outcomes for Phase 4 planning

- Rep ranges use TWO dots, not a dash. Correct: `3x8..12`. Wrong: `3x8-12` or `3x8-10`.
- Sets always come first: `3x10` means 3 sets of 10 reps.
- RPE goes after sets/reps: `3x8..12 rpe 7`.
- Rest in seconds: `rest 90 seconds`.
